# postprocessing

> An advanced, real-time post-processing library for three.js.

## Manual

- [Introduction](https://pmndrs.github.io/postprocessing/manual/index.md): architecture, concepts, compatibility, and performance
- [Getting Started](https://pmndrs.github.io/postprocessing/manual/getting-started/index.md): installation and first frame graph
- [Effects](https://pmndrs.github.io/postprocessing/manual/effects/index.md): built-in and custom effects
- [Passes](https://pmndrs.github.io/postprocessing/manual/passes/index.md): built-in and custom passes
- [Migration Guide](https://pmndrs.github.io/postprocessing/manual/migration-guide/index.md): changes between major versions
